items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, Histaklut Penimit 11:1
items.html:
Explains the third Partzuf of AK, called SAG of AK, which is at the level of Bina, and it contains two matters: A. That after Partzuf AB of AK was completed, the surrounding light returned and refined the coarseness of phase three to phase two, and ten Sefirot of Rosh Toch Sof were extended at the level of Bina, and it is called SAG of AK. B. That at first the screen that was in the Tabur rose to its root in the Peh, as written in AB of AK.

The refinement of the screen of phase three to phase two. There is no refinement in the screen of the Rosh, only in the screen of the Tabur
And after Partzuf AB of AK mentioned above was completed, it is found likewise, that the upper light that clothes in it, and the reflected light returned and refined the coarseness in it, in the manner mentioned above regarding Partzuf Galgalta of AK (see there in Chapter 10, item 4). And this is the coarseness of the screen that is in the Malchut of its Malchut, which is the Malchut of the Guf of AB, called Tabur as above, since in the Malchut of the Rosh, called Peh, no refinement occurs in any Partzuf whatsoever, since it serves from below upward, and the light is not at all confined within it, and therefore it does not refine it, and remember this.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, Histaklut Penimit 11:2
items.html:
The extension of Rosh Toch Sof of Partzuf SAG of AK
And after the Malchut of AB, called Tabur, was refined of all the coarseness in it, meaning of the coarseness of phase three, until it became as pure as the root, it is regarded that the Malchut rose to her Emanator, meaning to the Peh of the Rosh of AB of AK, since this Peh is the root and the Emanator for the ten Sefirot of the Guf of AB of AK, as above. And once she rose to the Peh, the root again bestowed upon her the coarseness as at first, except for the last discernment, which is lost and does not return (as above, Chapter 10, item 9), and it is found that the Malchut returned and became coarse there with the coarseness of phase two, which we call this coarsening by the name of descent to her place as at first, meaning in the Chazeh, close to the Tabur of AB of AK, from which she came (as above, Chapter 10, item 10), and again a coupling by striking was made there, and ten Sefirot of the Rosh were extended at the measure of the level of Bina, since the reflected light of phase two does not reach beyond this. And from there downward, ten Sefirot of Toch and ten Sefirot of Sof extended (as above, Chapter 10, items 9-10). And this Partzuf is called Partzuf SAG of AK, because it has only the level of Bina. And in this way, the rest of the Partzufim of AK came out.
